AlphastarPrivacy Policy

This notice explains what Alphastar Mobile handles, why it is needed, and how you can ask about your information. It covers your patient account, home-service requests, SMPE forms, saved drafts, security settings, and support.

The mobile-app notices are reproduced below, with separate sections for this website. Ask the clinic if anything is unclear.

Who this notice is for

This notice is for patients using Alphastar Mobile with Alphastar Laboratory & Multi-Specialty Clinic. Your personal and medical information is intended for your account and authorized clinic personnel, not other patients. This app notice does not replace any consent or information given to you for clinical care.

Information the app handles

The information depends on the features you use:

  • Account details: your name, email, contact number, sign-in provider, and account identifier. A profile image may also be associated with your account.
  • Profile and home-service details: your address, selected service, preferred date and time, notes, and appointment status or history.
  • Other clinic-linked records returned for your account, such as queue status or payment records, when present.
  • SMPE information: patient details, medical history, examination answers, vital signs, submission dates, and clinic review status or remarks.
  • Security information: sign-in sessions, protected PIN verification records, email-verification steps, and security-request status.
  • Service notifications, locally saved form drafts, and the information you choose to send to clinic support.

Why this information is used

The app uses information to identify your patient account, keep your details up to date, coordinate home-service requests, show your appointment and SMPE status, support clinic review, send service notices or verification emails, and help protect account access. Health information requires an appropriate legal basis, such as specific consent or another basis allowed by Philippine law. Reading this policy is not blanket consent for every use of your data.

Who may access your information

Authorized clinic staff and administrators may access information needed for their clinic duties. Technical providers process information needed to run the related app feature. Disclosure may also be required by a valid legal obligation. Ask the clinic about a particular disclosure or who has access to a specific record.

Services that help the app work

The app uses Google/Firebase for authentication, patient data, and uploaded files, and the clinic backend hosted on Render for supported account and appointment operations. Email providers deliver account-verification messages. Address lists come from PSGC Cloud; those requests retrieve location lists rather than send your full home address. Optional Agent Support uses tawk.to. These providers may process connection details and data needed for their service, including outside the Philippines. Opening an external website, email app, or support channel is also subject to that service's privacy practices.

Firebase privacy information tawk.to Privacy Policy

Saved forms and device storage

Unfinished SMPE, booking, reschedule, and profile forms can be saved as drafts on this device. A draft is not a submitted record or a confirmed appointment. On supported Android devices, persisted drafts are encrypted. Draft recovery has a seven-day window; expired saved drafts are rejected when read. Storage failures, clearing app data, or reinstalling can prevent recovery. The app also keeps patient-data caches and navigation information to help pages reopen. Not every cached copy uses the draft encryption layer. Protect your phone and sign out on shared devices.

Login, PIN, and email verification

You can sign in with email/password or Google. Google manages the Google account password; the app's Change Password flow is for email/password accounts. Account PINs use protected verification records rather than readable PIN values. The app normally locks after ten minutes of inactivity and returns to Home after a successful PIN unlock. Briefly switching apps should keep your current page. These safeguards reduce risk but cannot guarantee that a device or online service is always secure. Never share your PIN, password, or email code.

Chat With Us and Agent Support

The Help Bot uses built-in guides, not a generative AI service. It can use the account information supplied to the chat for supported status features. English/Tagalog choices, messages, timestamps, and like/dislike feedback are kept in that chat's app memory; feedback is not automatically sent to clinic staff. If you choose to connect to Agent Support, your account name, email, identifier, and a short conversation summary may be shared with tawk.to to provide context. Messages you send there are handled by that support service. Do not post passwords, PINs, email codes, or unnecessary medical information in chat.

Medical forms, printing, and notifications

Submitted SMPE forms are stored for clinic review. Pending, approved, or other review labels describe the form's status; they are not a diagnosis or a promise of clinical clearance. If you print or save a record using your phone's print tools, the resulting copy is outside the app's access controls. Keep it private. The app also displays service notifications; removing a notification does not remove the underlying appointment or medical record.

Retention, logout, and deletion requests

Logging out attempts to clear the current account's local drafts, cached patient data, and saved session. It does not delete your clinic account, submitted SMPE forms, or appointment history from the clinic's systems. Clinic records, provider logs, and backups can have different retention requirements. This app does not specify a fixed retention period for every server record. Ask the clinic for its record-specific schedule and how a deletion or account-closure request will be handled, including any information it must retain.

Your choices and privacy rights

You can review your profile and update editable details in the app. Under the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012, rights can include being informed, access, correction, objection or withdrawal of consent, and blocking or deletion where the legal conditions apply. You may also raise a complaint with the National Privacy Commission. Some requests are subject to applicable legal duties and exceptions. Ask the clinic to explain any limitation; there is no instant account-deletion button in this version.

Read the Data Privacy Act of 2012

Patients who need a guardian

If a patient is a minor or needs an authorized representative, ask clinic staff how the account and any required consent should be handled. Use only information you are authorized to provide. Do not assume that entering a guardian's details in an SMPE form replaces the clinic's consent process.

Privacy questions or concerns

Use Profile > Agent Support or email info@alphastarlabclinic.com and ask to speak with the person responsible for patient privacy. Say what you need, such as access, correction, account closure, or a privacy concern. The clinic may need to verify your identity. Do not include a password, PIN, verification code, or full medical record in an initial message.

Email Alphastar Clinic

Updates to this notice

Check the Last updated date when reviewing this notice. It should be revised when app features or clinic data practices change. A changed privacy notice does not remove your rights or replace any consent that is legally required for a new purpose. Ask the clinic if you need an explanation of a change.

This website and its Help Bot

This public website explains clinic services and the mobile app. Its Help Bot uses built-in replies, not a generative AI service, and does not sign you in, look up your patient account, retrieve SMPE records, or submit bookings. Chat messages, support drafts, timestamps, and like/dislike feedback stay in the current tab’s memory and reset on reload. Preparing an email draft or copying a message does not send it. You choose whether to send it through your email app or Messenger. Do not enter passwords, PINs, verification codes, or unnecessary medical details.

Website language and browser storage

The website saves your English/Tagalog preference in browser local storage so it can remember your choice on later visits. The Help Bot’s language is separate from the website’s language. Your browser may also cache page files. Clearing this website’s browser data can reset the saved preference. It does not delete your mobile-app account, clinic records, or messages you have sent through another service.

Website hosting, maps, and external links

Your browser connects to the website’s hosting service and, when loaded, Google Fonts and the embedded Google Map. These services may process connection details such as your IP address, browser information, and request details. Opening Messenger, email, directions, or an app-download link connects you to the relevant external service. Their privacy practices apply to those interactions. The website does not publish a fixed retention period for provider logs; ask the clinic about a specific concern.
